summary: Autodesk filed an 8-K to disclose the establishment of a $2.0 billion unsecured commercial paper program on July 13, 2026. The program allows issuance of notes with maturities up to 365 days, backstopped by an existing $2.0 billion revolving credit facility. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, including partial financing for the previously announced acquisition of MaintainX Inc. per the May 28, 2026 merger agreement. No notes have been issued yet. This event is routine financing, not a standalone special situation. Watch for any future issuer delays or market conditions affecting note placement.
